notes: Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). The guide's Sources note and the evidence's newest section were checked on the 23 October build (v0.1.78-c8526ae), where the #233 fixes were verified (combobox keyboard, options named by their labels, required and error announced, trimmed filter query); the evidence records no SuggestiveSearch change after c8526ae. Older evidence (Contract, 10 October; Review, 11 October) is from v0.1.78-636f3f5, the build the evidence names for that period, and is used only where the 23 October section does not replace it: the old keyboard, DOM and accessibility notes and the blur after a pick are not used. #209 (Enter firing twice) is not recorded as a gap: the 23 October re-test says Enter picks once. The Figma file's lack of Error, Read only and Disabled variants is a Figma-library fact, not a package gap, so it is not recorded. The published Storybook predating the build is not a component gap either. The guide names no other component to use instead, so avoidWhen is empty. Examples set no modes: the guide's configuration names none this content needs, and the in-context Card's AppearanceBrand Neutral only repeats the white fill Card has with no modes on this build.

examples.purpose: Adding a bank account: people type part of their bank’s name and pick it, then press Continue. The screen checks that a bank was picked; errorMessage shows only once it sets isInvalid, as in the error state.
examples.jsx:
<Card>
  <Card.Title>Add a bank account</Card.Title>
  <SuggestiveSearch
    label="Bank name"
    placeholder="Search bank name"
    items={['HDFC Bank', 'Himachal Pradesh Gramin Bank', 'ICICI Bank', 'State Bank of India', 'Axis Bank', 'Kotak Mahindra Bank', 'Punjab National Bank', 'Bank of Baroda', 'Canara Bank', 'Union Bank of India', 'IndusInd Bank', 'Yes Bank']}
    emptyMessage="No matching banks"
    errorMessage="Choose your bank from the list."
    onValueChange={() => {}}
  />
  <Button label="Continue" onPress={() => {}} />
</Card>

from.quote: Continue checks that a bank was picked from the list and shows an error if not

evidenceFacts.name: items
evidenceFacts.description: The screen owns the items and any loading; the component filters, caps, highlights the first match in bold, and shows a check on the selected row. An option object may set disabled: it stays listed and can't be chosen.
evidenceFacts.quote: The consumer owns `items` and any loading; the component filters, caps, highlights the first match in bold, and shows a check on the selected row.
